# Class: `CellSnapshot`

A compact geometry snapshot used by history, interpolation, and analysis.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-cell-items.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_cell_items.py#L10) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `object`.

`circle_positions` is the scene center; `circle_pixel_positions` is the center in original-image coordinates; `circle_sizes` is the radius. The ID connects this geometry to its cell record.
